en.headline: Catering labour import applications drop under tighter vetting rules
en.dek: Labour Department figures show 93 applications failed the new manning ratio since June, while completed cases in September mostly finished within four months.
body: The Labour Department has outlined the latest results of the tiered vetting system under the Enhanced Supplementary Labour Scheme for the catering sector. Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun provided the figures in reply to a Legislative Council question on Wednesday.

Since the tighter rules took effect on 16 June, production and table-service posts require a manning ratio of three full-time local employees to one imported worker, plus six weeks of local recruitment and regular attendance at Labour Department job fairs. Between mid-June and September, 93 applications failed preliminary screening because they did not meet the ratio requirement.

Overall applications also fell. The department received 1,905 applications involving 13,573 proposed imported workers from January to June, compared with 890 applications involving 4,996 workers from July to September. Of 330 applications completed in September after clearing preliminary screening, 289 finished within four months.

The government said it continues to monitor manpower needs and offers flexibility by calculating the manning ratio on total headcount within a section rather than by individual post. Employers who hire local persons with disabilities on a full-time basis can apply a one-to-one ratio for those employees.

zh.headline: 餐飲業輸入勞工申請在收緊審批後減少
zh.dek: 勞工處數據顯示，自六月起有93宗申請因未能符合人手比例而被拒，九月完成審批的個案大部分在四個月內處理完畢。
body: 勞工及福利局局長孫玉蕾周三在立法會答覆議員質詢時，公布「補充勞工優化計劃」餐飲業分級審批機制的最新情況。
自六月十六日起，出品部及樓面部職位須維持三名全職本地僱員對一名輸入勞工的比例，並須進行六星期本地招聘及定期出席勞工處招聘會。六月中至九月期間，共有93宗申請因不符人手比例規定而未通過初步甄別。
整體申請數目亦有下降。一至六月勞工處接獲1905宗申請，涉及13573名擬輸入勞工；七至九月則有890宗，涉及4996人。九月通過初步甄別後完成審批的330宗中，289宗在四個月內辦妥。
政府表示會持續監察人力需求，並已調整計算方式，以部門總人數而非個別職位計算人手比例，增加彈性。僱主如全職聘用本地殘疾人士，相關員工可獲放寬至一比一比例。
